# gh-1575: [BUG] macOS clipboard image: TIFF-only pasteboard reports no image; Ctrl+V ignores text clipboard

## Description

## Summary
`lib/src/cli/clipboard_reader.dart` `_readMacos` only reads `«class PNGf»` and `«class JPEG»`. When the macOS pasteboard holds only TIFF (e.g. an image copied from Preview or a browser), Ctrl+V and bracketed-paste image detection report `clipboard holds no image`.

## Verified (13 Oct)
- `osascript -e 'clipboard info'` lists `TIFF picture, AVIF, 8BPS, GIF...` with no `PNGf`.
- `set d to (the clipboard as «class PNGf»)` returns rc=1.

## Fix
- Add a fallback `«class TIFF»` and convert to PNG (`sips -s format png in --out out`, or ImageIO), then return it as `PasteboardImage`.
- Tests with the injectable `ProcessRunner` / `platform:` seam: PNGf fails, TIFF succeeds, conversion output used; conversion failure falls through to `PasteboardUnavailable`.

## Related UX gap
Ctrl+V with a TEXT clipboard does nothing (only the image probe runs; `_handlePasteImageKey` returns after the probe). Users expect the text to be pasted. On probe failure with a text clipboard, Ctrl+V should insert the clipboard text (via `pbpaste` / the platform reader) into the composer.

# PR Discussion History

_Previous review discussions for PR #1580._

> ℹ️ **1 machine notice(s) excluded (arming/status boilerplate — never reply targets).**

## Review Threads (Inline Comments)

### Thread 1 — `lib/src/cli/fa_tui.dart`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-13):
🚨 **BLOCKING: loc gate red — `fa_tui.dart` is 2807 lines > max 2800 (both failed CI checks trace to this)**

The `CRAP + duplication` job failed on exactly one gate (reproduced locally with the pinned `crap4dart 0.11.0`):

```
[FAIL] loc: 1/557 files over their limit
  lib/src/cli/fa_tui.dart: 2807 lines > max 2800
```

`fa_tui.dart` sat at exactly 2800 lines on `main` (zero headroom — issue #1234's ≤2800 wc-l gate, re-enshrined in `crap4dart.yaml` `gates.loc`). This PR adds 7 lines to that file (the `readClipboardText` ctor param + doc + field), pushing it to 2807. The `Quality gate` aggregate is red only because of this leg (`Quality gate FAILED: a leg is failure (guards)`). The CRAP ratchet itself passed and the duplication gate is a soft `[WARN]` — the loc gate is the single root cause.

This is the same reason `fa_tui_paste.dart` exists: its header says it was *"split out of `fa_tui.dart` to keep it under the repo's 2800-line size gate"*.

**Fix options:**
- Move `FaTuiCallbacks` (~120 lines, lines ~100-220) into a new part file (e.g. `fa_tui_callbacks.dart`, `part of 'fa_tui.dart'`) — part files are separate files, so `wc -l` on `fa_tui.dart` drops well under the cap and the zone-split precedent holds; **or**
- relocate ≥7 net lines of any self-contained member into an existing part file (`fa_tui_paste.dart` has headroom).

Note a doc-comment trim alone cannot fit: the ctor param + field are irreducible (2 lines) and the file is 7 over. The `max_lines` is "only down" — do not raise the threshold in `crap4dart.yaml`.

---

### Thread 2 — `lib/src/cli/clipboard_reader.dart`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-13):
⚠️ **IMPORTANT: Windows text read is not UTF-8 — non-ASCII clipboard text mojibakes**

`Get-Clipboard` runs under `powershell` (Windows PowerShell 5.1), whose redirected stdout is written in the OEM code page (e.g. cp437/cp850), **not** UTF-8. The output is then decoded as UTF-8 here with `allowMalformed: true`, so any non-ASCII clipboard text ("café", "Привет", CJK) silently degrades to U+FFFD replacement characters — exactly the lossy path this repo's image readers deliberately avoid: the pre-existing `_readWindows` image path never reads stdout (it writes a file and reads the bytes back, see `_readWindows` below in this file).

Secondary: `Get-Clipboard` formats each line with `\r\n`, so multi-line text keeps embedded `\r` after the single trailing-newline strip; the composer inserts verbatim (no `\r` normalization exists in the TUI paste path).

**Suggested fix** (mirror the image path's stdout avoidance, or pin the encoding):

```dart
final read = _textFromStdout(
  await runner('powershell', [
    '-NoProfile',
    '-Command',
    '[Console]::OutputEncoding=[System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8; Get-Clipboard',
  ]),
);
```

and normalize embedded `\r\n` → `\n` alongside the trailing strip. Untestable on the Linux CI runner, so at minimum worth a follow-up card — but as written, the Windows Ctrl+V text fallback corrupts everything outside ASCII.

---

### Thread 3 — `lib/src/cli/clipboard_reader.dart`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-13):
⚠️ **IMPORTANT: Linux text backends are not type-pinned — an image-only clipboard can be dumped into the composer as garbage "text"**

The image path pins explicit content types (`xclip … -t image/png`, `wl-paste --type image/png`), but the new text loop does not:

- `xclip -selection clipboard -o` defaults to `STRING`; on a clipboard that holds only image flavors it errors out (fine).
- `wl-paste --no-newline` **without `--type` pastes the first MIME type offered by the source** — for an image-only clipboard that is `image/png`/`image/jpeg`, exit code 0, stdout = raw image bytes.

Trigger path: clipboard holds only a non-PNG image (e.g. JPEG-only — the image reader only probes `image/png`), so `readPasteboardImage` misses → the Ctrl+V fallback runs → `wl-paste --no-newline` happily returns the image bytes → `_textFromStdout` decodes them with `allowMalformed: true` → a wall of mojibake `PasteboardText` is inserted into the composer (and one keypress away from being submitted).

**Suggested fix** — pin text types the way the image path does:

```dart
for (final (executable, args) in [
  ('xclip', ['-selection', 'clipboard', '-t', 'text/plain;charset=utf-8', '-o']),
  ('wl-paste', ['--type', 'text/plain;charset=utf-8', '--no-newline']),
]) {
```

With explicit types, an image-only clipboard fails both backends and keeps the correct named `'xclip/wl-paste unavailable or clipboard holds no text'` reason instead of pasting binary garbage.

---

### Thread 4 — `lib/src/cli/clipboard_reader.dart`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-13):
💡 **SUGGESTION: library doc overclaims — `FA_FAKE_PASTEBOARD` does not short-circuit the new text read**

The library header still says `FA_FAKE_PASTEBOARD=<path>` *"short-circuits everything"*. With gh-1575 the text path (`readPasteboardText`) does not consult that seam at all — it only short-circuits `readPasteboardImage`. Worth one line of doc so the next reader doesn't assume a text-flavored fake exists (or, alternatively, thread the same `environment` seam through `readPasteboardText` for PTY-golden symmetry).

---

### Thread 5 — `test/cli/clipboard_reader_test.dart`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-13):

## PR Description

Closes #1575
### Root Cause

`_readMacos` in `lib/src/cli/clipboard_reader.dart` probed only `«class PNGf»`/`«class JPEG»` — a TIFF-only pasteboard (Preview/browser copies) fails both and reports `clipboard holds no image`. Ctrl+V also fired only the image probe and returned, so a TEXT clipboard had no paste path at all.

### Fix

- `clipboard_reader.dart`: after PNGf/JPEG miss, probe `«class TIFF»` and convert to PNG via `sips -s format png <in> --out <out>`; conversion output becomes `PasteboardImage`, conversion failure keeps the `PasteboardUnavailable` fall-through; scratch files cleaned up.
- `clipboard_reader.dart`: new `readPasteboardText()` (`pbpaste` / `xclip`+`wl-paste` / PowerShell `Get-Clipboard`) behind the same injectable `ProcessRunner`/`platform:` seam; empty stdout = named unavailable.
- `paste_image.dart`: pure `PasteboardText` variant of the sealed `PasteboardRead` family.
- `fa_tui_paste.dart`: Ctrl+V wraps the image probe — image hit → chip (unchanged); miss → text read → inserted into the composer; neither → original named reason. New `readClipboardText` callback (real + web stub), wired in `agent_cli_repl_boot.dart`.

### Test Coverage

- `clipboard_reader_test.dart`: TIFF-only macOS → sips output used; failed conversion → unavailable; `readPasteboardText` per-platform (pbpaste hit/empty, xclip→wl-paste fallback, Windows newline strip).
- `fa_tui_paste_flow_test.dart`: text clipboard inserts; image preferred (text reader untouched); both miss → named reason; no text reader → legacy behavior.
- Full suite: 10547 passed, 10 skipped, 0 failures.

### Notes

- Bracketed-paste routing, gesture pairing (#1067) and silent-failure semantics unchanged; the text fallback rides Ctrl+V only.

# gh-1575: [BUG] macOS clipboard image: TIFF-only pasteboard reports no image; Ctrl+V ignores text clipboard

## Description

## Summary
`lib/src/cli/clipboard_reader.dart` `_readMacos` only reads `«class PNGf»` and `«class JPEG»`. When the macOS pasteboard holds only TIFF (e.g. an image copied from Preview or a browser), Ctrl+V and bracketed-paste image detection report `clipboard holds no image`.

## Verified (13 Oct)
- `osascript -e 'clipboard info'` lists `TIFF picture, AVIF, 8BPS, GIF...` with no `PNGf`.
- `set d to (the clipboard as «class PNGf»)` returns rc=1.

## Fix
- Add a fallback `«class TIFF»` and convert to PNG (`sips -s format png in --out out`, or ImageIO), then return it as `PasteboardImage`.
- Tests with the injectable `ProcessRunner` / `platform:` seam: PNGf fails, TIFF succeeds, conversion output used; conversion failure falls through to `PasteboardUnavailable`.

## Related UX gap
Ctrl+V with a TEXT clipboard does nothing (only the image probe runs; `_handlePasteImageKey` returns after the probe). Users expect the text to be pasted. On probe failure with a text clipboard, Ctrl+V should insert the clipboard text (via `pbpaste` / the platform reader) into the composer.

# PR Discussion History

_Previous review discussions for PR #1580._

> ℹ️ **1 machine notice(s) excluded (arming/status boilerplate — never reply targets).**

## Review Threads (Inline Comments)

### Thread 1 — `lib/src/cli/fa_tui.dart`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-13):
🚨 **BLOCKING: loc gate red — `fa_tui.dart` is 2807 lines > max 2800 (both failed CI checks trace to this)**

The `CRAP + duplication` job failed on exactly one gate (reproduced locally with the pinned `crap4dart 0.11.0`):

```
[FAIL] loc: 1/557 files over their limit
  lib/src/cli/fa_tui.dart: 2807 lines > max 2800
```

`fa_tui.dart` sat at exactly 2800 lines on `main` (zero headroom — issue #1234's ≤2800 wc-l gate, re-enshrined in `crap4dart.yaml` `gates.loc`). This PR adds 7 lines to that file (the `readClipboardText` ctor param + doc + field), pushing it to 2807. The `Quality gate` aggregate is red only because of this leg (`Quality gate FAILED: a leg is failure (guards)`). The CRAP ratchet itself passed and the duplication gate is a soft `[WARN]` — the loc gate is the single root cause.

This is the same reason `fa_tui_paste.dart` exists: its header says it was *"split out of `fa_tui.dart` to keep it under the repo's 2800-line size gate"*.

**Fix options:**
- Move `FaTuiCallbacks` (~120 lines, lines ~100-220) into a new part file (e.g. `fa_tui_callbacks.dart`, `part of 'fa_tui.dart'`) — part files are separate files, so `wc -l` on `fa_tui.dart` drops well under the cap and the zone-split precedent holds; **or**
- relocate ≥7 net lines of any self-contained member into an existing part file (`fa_tui_paste.dart` has headroom).

Note a doc-comment trim alone cannot fit: the ctor param + field are irreducible (2 lines) and the file is 7 over. The `max_lines` is "only down" — do not raise the threshold in `crap4dart.yaml`.

---

### Thread 2 — `lib/src/cli/clipboard_reader.dart`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-13):
⚠️ **IMPORTANT: Windows text read is not UTF-8 — non-ASCII clipboard text mojibakes**

`Get-Clipboard` runs under `powershell` (Windows PowerShell 5.1), whose redirected stdout is written in the OEM code page (e.g. cp437/cp850), **not** UTF-8. The output is then decoded as UTF-8 here with `allowMalformed: true`, so any non-ASCII clipboard text ("café", "Привет", CJK) silently degrades to U+FFFD replacement characters — exactly the lossy path this repo's image readers deliberately avoid: the pre-existing `_readWindows` image path never reads stdout (it writes a file and reads the bytes back, see `_readWindows` below in this file).

Secondary: `Get-Clipboard` formats each line with `\r\n`, so multi-line text keeps embedded `\r` after the single trailing-newline strip; the composer inserts verbatim (no `\r` normalization exists in the TUI paste path).

**Suggested fix** (mirror the image path's stdout avoidance, or pin the encoding):

```dart
final read = _textFromStdout(
  await runner('powershell', [
    '-NoProfile',
    '-Command',
    '[Console]::OutputEncoding=[System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8; Get-Clipboard',
  ]),
);
```

and normalize embedded `\r\n` → `\n` alongside the trailing strip. Untestable on the Linux CI runner, so at minimum worth a follow-up card — but as written, the Windows Ctrl+V text fallback corrupts everything outside ASCII.

---

### Thread 3 — `lib/src/cli/clipboard_reader.dart`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-13):
⚠️ **IMPORTANT: Linux text backends are not type-pinned — an image-only clipboard can be dumped into the composer as garbage "text"**

The image path pins explicit content types (`xclip … -t image/png`, `wl-paste --type image/png`), but the new text loop does not:

- `xclip -selection clipboard -o` defaults to `STRING`; on a clipboard that holds only image flavors it errors out (fine).
- `wl-paste --no-newline` **without `--type` pastes the first MIME type offered by the source** — for an image-only clipboard that is `image/png`/`image/jpeg`, exit code 0, stdout = raw image bytes.

Trigger path: clipboard holds only a non-PNG image (e.g. JPEG-only — the image reader only probes `image/png`), so `readPasteboardImage` misses → the Ctrl+V fallback runs → `wl-paste --no-newline` happily returns the image bytes → `_textFromStdout` decodes them with `allowMalformed: true` → a wall of mojibake `PasteboardText` is inserted into the composer (and one keypress away from being submitted).

**Suggested fix** — pin text types the way the image path does:

```dart
for (final (executable, args) in [
  ('xclip', ['-selection', 'clipboard', '-t', 'text/plain;charset=utf-8', '-o']),
  ('wl-paste', ['--type', 'text/plain;charset=utf-8', '--no-newline']),
]) {
```

With explicit types, an image-only clipboard fails both backends and keeps the correct named `'xclip/wl-paste unavailable or clipboard holds no text'` reason instead of pasting binary garbage.

---

### Thread 4 — `lib/src/cli/clipboard_reader.dart`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-13):
💡 **SUGGESTION: library doc overclaims — `FA_FAKE_PASTEBOARD` does not short-circuit the new text read**

The library header still says `FA_FAKE_PASTEBOARD=<path>` *"short-circuits everything"*. With gh-1575 the text path (`readPasteboardText`) does not consult that seam at all — it only short-circuits `readPasteboardImage`. Worth one line of doc so the next reader doesn't assume a text-flavored fake exists (or, alternatively, thread the same `environment` seam through `readPasteboardText` for PTY-golden symmetry).

---

### Thread 5 — `test/cli/clipboard_reader_test.dart`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-13):
💡 **SUGGESTION: `dart format` dirt introduced in this test file**

`dart format` (SDK stable 3.13.5 — the same SDK CI pins) reformats the renamed test at this line (long test-name wrapping style). The file was format-clean on `main`; the rename re-introduced dirt. CI doesn't gate format (the pre-commit hook self-heals staged files), so this is polish only — run `dart format test/cli/clipboard_reader_test.dart` before the next push.

Note: `clipboard_reader.dart`, `fa_tui_stub.dart` and `fa_tui_paste_flow_test.dart` are also format-dirty, but they were already dirty on `main` (pre-existing SDK drift) — no need to touch those in this PR.

---

### Thread 6

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-13):
## Automated Code Review — REQUEST_CHANGES

**Summary**: CI is red with a single root cause: `fa_tui.dart` grew to 2807 lines against the 2800-line loc gate (`[FAIL] loc: 1/557 files over their limit` — reproduced locally with the pinned `crap4dart 0.11.0`; the `Quality gate` aggregate is red only through this leg). The gh-1575 fix itself is well-built: TIFF fallback + `sips` conversion, the injectable `readPasteboardText`, prompt-mode routing preserved, and 36/36 targeted tests pass (`dart analyze` clean on the changed lib files).

**Key Issues**:
1. 🚨 BLOCKING — `lib/src/cli/fa_tui.dart`: 2807 > 2800 loc gate → both failed CI checks (`CRAP + duplication`, then the aggregate `Quality gate`). Fix by relocating lines into a part file (repo precedent: `fa_tui_paste.dart`); do not raise `max_lines`.
2. ⚠️ IMPORTANT — Windows text read: PowerShell 5.1 stdout is OEM-encoded, not UTF-8 → non-ASCII clipboard text mojibakes; embedded `\r\n` also survives the single trailing strip.
3. ⚠️ IMPORTANT — Linux text read: backends not type-pinned; `wl-paste --no-newline` without `--type` can dump image bytes as "text" when the image probe missed (e.g. JPEG-only clipboard) → garbage inserted into the composer.
4. 💡 SUGGESTION — `FA_FAKE_PASTEBOARD` doc drift ("short-circuits everything" — the text path ignores it); 💡 SUGGESTION — `dart format` dirt newly introduced in `test/cli/clipboard_reader_test.dart`.

1. Get `fa_tui.dart` back under 2800 lines (move `FaTuiCallbacks` or an equivalent self-contained block into a part file), re-push, and let the SM validation go green.

# PR Discussion History

_Previous review discussions for PR #1580._

> ℹ️ **1 machine notice(s) excluded (arming/status boilerplate — never reply targets).**

## Review Threads (Inline Comments)

### Thread 1 — `lib/src/cli/fa_tui.dart`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-13):
🚨 **BLOCKING: loc gate red — `fa_tui.dart` is 2807 lines > max 2800 (both failed CI checks trace to this)**

The `CRAP + duplication` job failed on exactly one gate (reproduced locally with the pinned `crap4dart 0.11.0`):

```
[FAIL] loc: 1/557 files over their limit
  lib/src/cli/fa_tui.dart: 2807 lines > max 2800
```

`fa_tui.dart` sat at exactly 2800 lines on `main` (zero headroom — issue #1234's ≤2800 wc-l gate, re-enshrined in `crap4dart.yaml` `gates.loc`). This PR adds 7 lines to that file (the `readClipboardText` ctor param + doc + field), pushing it to 2807. The `Quality gate` aggregate is red only because of this leg (`Quality gate FAILED: a leg is failure (guards)`). The CRAP ratchet itself passed and the duplication gate is a soft `[WARN]` — the loc gate is the single root cause.

This is the same reason `fa_tui_paste.dart` exists: its header says it was *"split out of `fa_tui.dart` to keep it under the repo's 2800-line size gate"*.

**Fix options:**
- Move `FaTuiCallbacks` (~120 lines, lines ~100-220) into a new part file (e.g. `fa_tui_callbacks.dart`, `part of 'fa_tui.dart'`) — part files are separate files, so `wc -l` on `fa_tui.dart` drops well under the cap and the zone-split precedent holds; **or**
- relocate ≥7 net lines of any self-contained member into an existing part file (`fa_tui_paste.dart` has headroom).

Note a doc-comment trim alone cannot fit: the ctor param + field are irreducible (2 lines) and the file is 7 over. The `max_lines` is "only down" — do not raise the threshold in `crap4dart.yaml`.

---

### Thread 2 — `lib/src/cli/clipboard_reader.dart`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-13):
⚠️ **IMPORTANT: Windows text read is not UTF-8 — non-ASCII clipboard text mojibakes**

`Get-Clipboard` runs under `powershell` (Windows PowerShell 5.1), whose redirected stdout is written in the OEM code page (e.g. cp437/cp850), **not** UTF-8. The output is then decoded as UTF-8 here with `allowMalformed: true`, so any non-ASCII clipboard text ("café", "Привет", CJK) silently degrades to U+FFFD replacement characters — exactly the lossy path this repo's image readers deliberately avoid: the pre-existing `_readWindows` image path never reads stdout (it writes a file and reads the bytes back, see `_readWindows` below in this file).

Secondary: `Get-Clipboard` formats each line with `\r\n`, so multi-line text keeps embedded `\r` after the single trailing-newline strip; the composer inserts verbatim (no `\r` normalization exists in the TUI paste path).

**Suggested fix** (mirror the image path's stdout avoidance, or pin the encoding):

```dart
final read = _textFromStdout(
  await runner('powershell', [
    '-NoProfile',
    '-Command',
    '[Console]::OutputEncoding=[System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8; Get-Clipboard',
  ]),
);
```

and normalize embedded `\r\n` → `\n` alongside the trailing strip. Untestable on the Linux CI runner, so at minimum worth a follow-up card — but as written, the Windows Ctrl+V text fallback corrupts everything outside ASCII.

---

### Thread 3 — `lib/src/cli/clipboard_reader.dart`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-13):
⚠️ **IMPORTANT: Linux text backends are not type-pinned — an image-only clipboard can be dumped into the composer as garbage "text"**

The image path pins explicit content types (`xclip … -t image/png`, `wl-paste --type image/png`), but the new text loop does not:

- `xclip -selection clipboard -o` defaults to `STRING`; on a clipboard that holds only image flavors it errors out (fine).
- `wl-paste --no-newline` **without `--type` pastes the first MIME type offered by the source** — for an image-only clipboard that is `image/png`/`image/jpeg`, exit code 0, stdout = raw image bytes.

Trigger path: clipboard holds only a non-PNG image (e.g. JPEG-only — the image reader only probes `image/png`), so `readPasteboardImage` misses → the Ctrl+V fallback runs → `wl-paste --no-newline` happily returns the image bytes → `_textFromStdout` decodes them with `allowMalformed: true` → a wall of mojibake `PasteboardText` is inserted into the composer (and one keypress away from being submitted).

**Suggested fix** — pin text types the way the image path does:

```dart
for (final (executable, args) in [
  ('xclip', ['-selection', 'clipboard', '-t', 'text/plain;charset=utf-8', '-o']),
  ('wl-paste', ['--type', 'text/plain;charset=utf-8', '--no-newline']),
]) {
```

With explicit types, an image-only clipboard fails both backends and keeps the correct named `'xclip/wl-paste unavailable or clipboard holds no text'` reason instead of pasting binary garbage.

---

### Thread 4 — `lib/src/cli/clipboard_reader.dart`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-13):
💡 **SUGGESTION: library doc overclaims — `FA_FAKE_PASTEBOARD` does not short-circuit the new text read**

The library header still says `FA_FAKE_PASTEBOARD=<path>` *"short-circuits everything"*. With gh-1575 the text path (`readPasteboardText`) does not consult that seam at all — it only short-circuits `readPasteboardImage`. Worth one line of doc so the next reader doesn't assume a text-flavored fake exists (or, alternatively, thread the same `environment` seam through `readPasteboardText` for PTY-golden symmetry).

---

### Thread 5 — `test/cli/clipboard_reader_test.dart`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-13):
💡 **SUGGESTION: `dart format` dirt introduced in this test file**

`dart format` (SDK stable 3.13.5 — the same SDK CI pins) reformats the renamed test at this line (long test-name wrapping style). The file was format-clean on `main`; the rename re-introduced dirt. CI doesn't gate format (the pre-commit hook self-heals staged files), so this is polish only — run `dart format test/cli/clipboard_reader_test.dart` before the next push.

Note: `clipboard_reader.dart`, `fa_tui_stub.dart` and `fa_tui_paste_flow_test.dart` are also format-dirty, but they were already dirty on `main` (pre-existing SDK drift) — no need to touch those in this PR.

**Summary**: CI is red with a single root cause: `fa_tui.dart` grew to 2807 lines against the 2800-line loc gate (`[FAIL] loc: 1/557 files over their limit` — reproduced locally with the pinned `crap4dart 0.11.0`; the `Quality gate` aggregate is red only through this leg). # PR Discussion History

_Previous review discussions for PR #1580._

> ℹ️ **1 machine notice(s) excluded (arming/status boilerplate — never reply targets).**

## Review Threads (Inline Comments)

### Thread 1 — `lib/src/cli/fa_tui.dart`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-13):
🚨 **BLOCKING: loc gate red — `fa_tui.dart` is 2807 lines > max 2800 (both failed CI checks trace to this)**

The `CRAP + duplication` job failed on exactly one gate (reproduced locally with the pinned `crap4dart 0.11.0`):

```
[FAIL] loc: 1/557 files over their limit
  lib/src/cli/fa_tui.dart: 2807 lines > max 2800
```

`fa_tui.dart` sat at exactly 2800 lines on `main` (zero headroom — issue #1234's ≤2800 wc-l gate, re-enshrined in `crap4dart.yaml` `gates.loc`). This PR adds 7 lines to that file (the `readClipboardText` ctor param + doc + field), pushing it to 2807. The `Quality gate` aggregate is red only because of this leg (`Quality gate FAILED: a leg is failure (guards)`). The CRAP ratchet itself passed and the duplication gate is a soft `[WARN]` — the loc gate is the single root cause.

This is the same reason `fa_tui_paste.dart` exists: its header says it was *"split out of `fa_tui.dart` to keep it under the repo's 2800-line size gate"*.

**Fix options:**
- Move `FaTuiCallbacks` (~120 lines, lines ~100-220) into a new part file (e.g. `fa_tui_callbacks.dart`, `part of 'fa_tui.dart'`) — part files are separate files, so `wc -l` on `fa_tui.dart` drops well under the cap and the zone-split precedent holds; **or**
- relocate ≥7 net lines of any self-contained member into an existing part file (`fa_tui_paste.dart` has headroom).

Note a doc-comment trim alone cannot fit: the ctor param + field are irreducible (2 lines) and the file is 7 over. The `max_lines` is "only down" — do not raise the threshold in `crap4dart.yaml`.

---

### Thread 2 — `lib/src/cli/clipboard_reader.dart`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-13):
⚠️ **IMPORTANT: Windows text read is not UTF-8 — non-ASCII clipboard text mojibakes**

`Get-Clipboard` runs under `powershell` (Windows PowerShell 5.1), whose redirected stdout is written in the OEM code page (e.g. cp437/cp850), **not** UTF-8. The output is then decoded as UTF-8 here with `allowMalformed: true`, so any non-ASCII clipboard text ("café", "Привет", CJK) silently degrades to U+FFFD replacement characters — exactly the lossy path this repo's image readers deliberately avoid: the pre-existing `_readWindows` image path never reads stdout (it writes a file and reads the bytes back, see `_readWindows` below in this file).

Secondary: `Get-Clipboard` formats each line with `\r\n`, so multi-line text keeps embedded `\r` after the single trailing-newline strip; the composer inserts verbatim (no `\r` normalization exists in the TUI paste path).

**Suggested fix** (mirror the image path's stdout avoidance, or pin the encoding):

```dart
final read = _textFromStdout(
  await runner('powershell', [
    '-NoProfile',
    '-Command',
    '[Console]::OutputEncoding=[System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8; Get-Clipboard',
  ]),
);
```

and normalize embedded `\r\n` → `\n` alongside the trailing strip. Untestable on the Linux CI runner, so at minimum worth a follow-up card — but as written, the Windows Ctrl+V text fallback corrupts everything outside ASCII.

---

### Thread 3 — `lib/src/cli/clipboard_reader.dart`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-13):
⚠️ **IMPORTANT: Linux text backends are not type-pinned — an image-only clipboard can be dumped into the composer as garbage "text"**

The image path pins explicit content types (`xclip … -t image/png`, `wl-paste --type image/png`), but the new text loop does not:

- `xclip -selection clipboard -o` defaults to `STRING`; on a clipboard that holds only image flavors it errors out (fine).
- `wl-paste --no-newline` **without `--type` pastes the first MIME type offered by the source** — for an image-only clipboard that is `image/png`/`image/jpeg`, exit code 0, stdout = raw image bytes.

Trigger path: clipboard holds only a non-PNG image (e.g. JPEG-only — the image reader only probes `image/png`), so `readPasteboardImage` misses → the Ctrl+V fallback runs → `wl-paste --no-newline` happily returns the image bytes → `_textFromStdout` decodes them with `allowMalformed: true` → a wall of mojibake `PasteboardText` is inserted into the composer (and one keypress away from being submitted).

**Suggested fix** — pin text types the way the image path does:

```dart
for (final (executable, args) in [
  ('xclip', ['-selection', 'clipboard', '-t', 'text/plain;charset=utf-8', '-o']),
  ('wl-paste', ['--type', 'text/plain;charset=utf-8', '--no-newline']),
]) {
```

With explicit types, an image-only clipboard fails both backends and keeps the correct named `'xclip/wl-paste unavailable or clipboard holds no text'` reason instead of pasting binary garbage.

---

### Thread 4 — `lib/src/cli/clipboard_reader.dart`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-13):
💡 **SUGGESTION: library doc overclaims — `FA_FAKE_PASTEBOARD` does not short-circuit the new text read**

The library header still says `FA_FAKE_PASTEBOARD=<path>` *"short-circuits everything"*. With gh-1575 the text path (`readPasteboardText`) does not consult that seam at all — it only short-circuits `readPasteboardImage`. Worth one line of doc so the next reader doesn't assume a text-flavored fake exists (or, alternatively, thread the same `environment` seam through `readPasteboardText` for PTY-golden symmetry).

---

### Thread 5 — `test/cli/clipboard_reader_test.dart`

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-13):
💡 **SUGGESTION: `dart format` dirt introduced in this test file**

`dart format` (SDK stable 3.13.5 — the same SDK CI pins) reformats the renamed test at this line (long test-name wrapping style). The file was format-clean on `main`; the rename re-introduced dirt. CI doesn't gate format (the pre-commit hook self-heals staged files), so this is polish only — run `dart format test/cli/clipboard_reader_test.dart` before the next push.

Note: `clipboard_reader.dart`, `fa_tui_stub.dart` and `fa_tui_paste_flow_test.dart` are also format-dirty, but they were already dirty on `main` (pre-existing SDK drift) — no need to touch those in this PR.

---

### Thread 6

**ai-teammate** (2026-10-13):
## Automated Code Review — REQUEST_CHANGES

**Summary**: CI is red with a single root cause: `fa_tui.dart` grew to 2807 lines against the 2800-line loc gate (`[FAIL] loc: 1/557 files over their limit` — reproduced locally with the pinned `crap4dart 0.11.0`; the `Quality gate` aggregate is red only through this leg). The gh-1575 fix itself is well-built: TIFF fallback + `sips` conversion, the injectable `readPasteboardText`, prompt-mode routing preserved, and 36/36 targeted tests pass (`dart analyze` clean on the changed lib files).

**Key Issues**:
1. 🚨 BLOCKING — `lib/src/cli/fa_tui.dart`: 2807 > 2800 loc gate → both failed CI checks (`CRAP + duplication`, then the aggregate `Quality gate`). Fix by relocating lines into a part file (repo precedent: `fa_tui_paste.dart`); do not raise `max_lines`.
2. ⚠️ IMPORTANT — Windows text read: PowerShell 5.1 stdout is OEM-encoded, not UTF-8 → non-ASCII clipboard text mojibakes; embedded `\r\n` also survives the single trailing strip.

4. 💡 SUGGESTION — `FA_FAKE_PASTEBOARD` doc drift ("short-circuits everything" — the text path ignores it); 💡 SUGGESTION — `dart format` dirt newly introduced in `test/cli/clipboard_reader_test.dart`.

**Next Steps**:
1. Get `fa_tui.dart` back under 2800 lines (move `FaTuiCallbacks` or an equivalent self-contained block into a part file), re-push, and let the SM validation go green.
2. Pin UTF-8 on the Windows `Get-Clipboard` invocation (or read via a scratch file like the image path) and normalize `\r\n` → `\n`.
3. Pin text types on the Linux text backends (`-t text/plain;charset=utf-8` / `--type text/plain;charset=utf-8`).
4. Optional polish: `dart format test/cli/clipboard_reader_test.dart` + one doc line for the fake-pasteboard seam.

);

);

```dart

  ('wl-paste', ['--type', 'text/plain;charset=utf-8', '--no-newline']),

```

content.text:
## Unreleased

- gh-1575: macOS clipboard paste fixed for TIFF-only pasteboards + the
  Ctrl+V text fallback. `_readMacos` probes `«class TIFF»` after PNGf/JPEG
  miss and converts via `sips -s format png` (a Preview/browser copy used
  to dead-end on `clipboard holds no image`; a failed conversion keeps the
  unavailable fall-through and every scratch file is cleaned up); new
  `readPasteboardText` (`pbpaste` / xclip+wl-paste / PowerShell
  Get-Clipboard) behind the same injectable `ProcessRunner`/`platform:`
  seam, and Ctrl+V with a TEXT clipboard now inserts the clipboard text
  into the composer instead of printing the image probe's dead-end reason
  — bracketed-paste routing, gesture pairing and silent-failure semantics
  unchanged.

- gh-1556: bench pipeline stops bleeding score + fa deadline awareness.
  Bench: the harbor ladder kill uses the `[f]a` bracket trick and is
  wrapped so a kill failure can never replace the `TimeoutError` (the
  pre-fix self-matching `pkill` classified TB 2.0 ladder kills as agent
  crashes — a SOLVED task scored 0); progress-watch (stall-gap 360s per

## Unreleased

- gh-1575: macOS clipboard paste fixed for TIFF-only pasteboards + the
  Ctrl+V text fallback. `_readMacos` probes `«class TIFF»` after PNGf/JPEG

  unavailable fall-through and every scratch file is cleaned up); new
  `readPasteboardText` (`pbpaste` / xclip+wl-paste / PowerShell
  Get-Clipboard) behind the same injectable `ProcessRunner`/`platform:`
  seam, and Ctrl+V with a TEXT clipboard now inserts the clipboard text
  into the composer instead of printing the image probe's dead-end reason
  — bracketed-paste routing, gesture pairing and silent-failure semantics
  unchanged.

## Fixed — Windows text read is now UTF-8-pinned and CRLF-normalized

`_readWindowsText` (`lib/src/cli/clipboard_reader.dart`) mirrors the suggested fix:

```dart
await runner('powershell', [
  '-NoProfile',
  '-Command',
  '[Console]::OutputEncoding=[System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8; Get-Clipboard',
])
```

- UTF-8 console output encoding pinned on the same command line, so the stream the reader decodes is UTF-8 — non-ASCII clipboard text ("café", "Привет", CJK) no longer degrades to U+FFFD.
- Embedded line breaks normalized: after the single PowerShell trailing-newline strip, every remaining `\r\n` becomes `\n` (`replaceAll`), so multi-line clipboard text reaches the composer verbatim as the clipboard held it.

Regression tests in `test/cli/clipboard_reader_test.dart`:
- `the Windows text command pins UTF-8 on the console encoding` — asserts the emitted command carries the `[Console]::OutputEncoding=...::UTF8` pin and `Get-Clipboard`
- `the Windows text path normalizes embedded CRLF to LF` — `line one\r\nline two\r\n` → `line one\nline two`

(Host-side OEM-encoding behavior itself stays untestable on the Linux CI runner, as noted — the command contract and the normalization are pinned by tests.)

## Fixed — Linux text backends are type-pinned exactly as suggested

`_readLinuxText` (`lib/src/cli/clipboard_reader.dart`) now pins the text types the same way the image path pins `image/png`:

```dart
for (final (executable, args) in [
  ('xclip', ['-selection', 'clipboard', '-t', 'text/plain;charset=utf-8', '-o']),
  ('wl-paste', ['--type', 'text/plain;charset=utf-8', '--no-newline']),
]) {
```

- With explicit types, an image-only clipboard (e.g. JPEG-only — the image reader only probes `image/png`) fails both backends and the Ctrl+V fallback keeps the correct named `xclip/wl-paste unavailable or clipboard holds no text` reason instead of decoding raw image bytes into a mojibake `PasteboardText`.

Regression tests in `test/cli/clipboard_reader_test.dart`:
- `the Linux text backends pin the text content type` — asserts xclip gets `-t text/plain;charset=utf-8` and wl-paste gets `--type text/plain;charset=utf-8`
- `an image-only Linux clipboard is not dumped into the composer` — both pinned backends failing yields the named unavailable, never text

## Fixed — library doc no longer overclaims the fake-pasteboard seam

`lib/src/cli/clipboard_reader.dart` header now reads:

> `FA_FAKE_PASTEBOARD=<path>` short-circuits the **IMAGE** read: that file is returned as-is — the test seam for the PTY golden tests (and handy for debugging on a headless box). The TEXT read has no fake seam — it consults only the real platform pasteboard (script it with the injected `ProcessRunner`).

{"content":"## Fixed — Windows text read is now UTF-8-pinned and CRLF-normalized

`_readWindowsText` (`lib/src/cli/clipboard_reader.dart`) mirrors the suggested fix:

```dart
await runner('powershell', [
  '-NoProfile',
  '-Command',
  '[Console]::OutputEncoding=[System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8; Get-Clipboard',
])
```

- UTF-8 console output encoding pinned on the same command line, so the stream the reader decodes is UTF-8 — non-ASCII clipboard text ("café", "Привет", CJK) no longer degrades to U+FFFD.
- Embedded line breaks normalized: after the single PowerShell trailing-newline strip, every remaining `\r\n` becomes `\n` (`replaceAll`), so multi-line clipboard text reaches the composer verbatim as the clipboard held it.

Regression tests in `test/cli/clipboard_reader_test.dart`:
- `the Windows text command pins UTF-8 on the console encoding` — asserts the emitted command carries the `[Console]::OutputEncoding=...::UTF8` pin and `Get-Clipboard`
- `the Windows text path normalizes embedded CRLF to LF` — `line one\r\nline two\r\n` → `line one\nline two`

(Host-side OEM-encoding behavior itself stays untestable on the Linux CI runner, as noted — the command contract and the normalization are pinned by tests.)
","path":"outputs/review_replies/thread_2.md"}

{"content":"## Fixed — Linux text backends are type-pinned exactly as suggested

`_readLinuxText` (`lib/src/cli/clipboard_reader.dart`) now pins the text types the same way the image path pins `image/png`:

```dart
for (final (executable, args) in [
  ('xclip', ['-selection', 'clipboard', '-t', 'text/plain;charset=utf-8', '-o']),
  ('wl-paste', ['--type', 'text/plain;charset=utf-8', '--no-newline']),
]) {
```

- With explicit types, an image-only clipboard (e.g. JPEG-only — the image reader only probes `image/png`) fails both backends and the Ctrl+V fallback keeps the correct named `xclip/wl-paste unavailable or clipboard holds no text` reason instead of decoding raw image bytes into a mojibake `PasteboardText`.

- `the Linux text backends pin the text content type` — asserts xclip gets `-t text/plain;charset=utf-8` and wl-paste gets `--type text/plain;charset=utf-8`
- `an image-only Linux clipboard is not dumped into the composer` — both pinned backends failing yields the named unavailable, never text
","path":"outputs/review_replies/thread_3.md"}

{"content":"## Fixed — Windows text read is now UTF-8-pinned and CRLF-normalized

`_readWindowsText` (`lib/src/cli/clipboard_reader.dart`) mirrors the suggested fix:

```dart
await runner('powershell', [
  '-NoProfile',
  '-Command',
  '[Console]::OutputEncoding=[System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8; Get-Clipboard',
])
```

- UTF-8 console output encoding pinned on the same command line, so the stream the reader decodes is UTF-8 — non-ASCII clipboard text ("café", "Привет", CJK) no longer degrades to U+FFFD.
- Embedded line breaks normalized: after the single PowerShell trailing-newline strip, every remaining `\r\n` becomes `\n` (`replaceAll`), so multi-line clipboard text reaches the composer verbatim as the clipboard held it.

Regression tests in `test/cli/clipboard_reader_test.dart`:
- `the Windows text command pins UTF-8 on the console encoding` — asserts the emitted command carries the `[Console]::OutputEncoding=...::UTF8` pin and `Get-Clipboard`
- `the Windows text path normalizes embedded CRLF to LF` — `line one\r\nline two\r\n` → `line one\nline two`

(Host-side OEM-encoding behavior itself stays untestable on the Linux CI runner, as noted — the command contract and the normalization are pinned by tests.)
","path":"outputs/review_replies/thread_2.md"}

{"content":"## Fixed — Linux text backends are type-pinned exactly as suggested

`_readLinuxText` (`lib/src/cli/clipboard_reader.dart`) now pins the text types the same way the image path pins `image/png`:

```dart
for (final (executable, args) in [
  ('xclip', ['-selection', 'clipboard', '-t', 'text/plain;charset=utf-8', '-o']),
  ('wl-paste', ['--type', 'text/plain;charset=utf-8', '--no-newline']),
]) {
```

- With explicit types, an image-only clipboard (e.g. JPEG-only — the image reader only probes `image/png`) fails both backends and the Ctrl+V fallback keeps the correct named `xclip/wl-paste unavailable or clipboard holds no text` reason instead of decoding raw image bytes into a mojibake `PasteboardText`.

Regression tests in `test/cli/clipboard_reader_test.dart`:
- `the Linux text backends pin the text content type` — asserts xclip gets `-t text/plain;charset=utf-8` and wl-paste gets `--type text/plain;charset=utf-8`
- `an image-only Linux clipboard is not dumped into the composer` — both pinned backends failing yields the named unavailable, never text
","path":"outputs/review_replies/thread_3.md"}

{"content":"## Fixed — library doc no longer overclaims the fake-pasteboard seam

`lib/src/cli/clipboard_reader.dart` header now reads:

> `FA_FAKE_PASTEBOARD=<path>` short-circuits the **IMAGE** read: that file is returned as-is — the test seam for the PTY golden tests (and handy for debugging on a headless box). await runner('powershell', [

  '-Command',

for (final (executable, args) in [

{"content":"## Fixed — Windows text read is now UTF-8-pinned and CRLF-normalized

`_readWindowsText` (`lib/src/cli/clipboard_reader.dart`) mirrors the suggested fix:

```dart
await runner('powershell', [
  '-NoProfile',
  '-Command',
  '[Console]::OutputEncoding=[System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8; Get-Clipboard',
])
```

- UTF-8 console output encoding pinned on the same command line, so the stream the reader decodes is UTF-8 — non-ASCII clipboard text ("café", "Привет", CJK) no longer degrades to U+FFFD.
- Embedded line breaks normalized: after the single PowerShell trailing-newline strip, every remaining `\r\n` becomes `\n` (`replaceAll`), so multi-line clipboard text reaches the composer verbatim as the clipboard held it.

Regression tests in `test/cli/clipboard_reader_test.dart`:
- `the Windows text command pins UTF-8 on the console encoding` — asserts the emitted command carries the `[Console]::OutputEncoding=...::UTF8` pin and `Get-Clipboard`
- `the Windows text path normalizes embedded CRLF to LF` — `line one\r\nline two\r\n` → `line one\nline two`

(Host-side OEM-encoding behavior itself stays untestable on the Linux CI runner, as noted — the command contract and the normalization are pinned by tests.)
","path":"outputs/review_replies/thread_2.md"}

{"content":"## Fixed — Linux text backends are type-pinned exactly as suggested

`_readLinuxText` (`lib/src/cli/clipboard_reader.dart`) now pins the text types the same way the image path pins `image/png`:

```dart
for (final (executable, args) in [
  ('xclip', ['-selection', 'clipboard', '-t', 'text/plain;charset=utf-8', '-o']),
  ('wl-paste', ['--type', 'text/plain;charset=utf-8', '--no-newline']),
]) {
```

- With explicit types, an image-only clipboard (e.g. JPEG-only — the image reader only probes `image/png`) fails both backends and the Ctrl+V fallback keeps the correct named `xclip/wl-paste unavailable or clipboard holds no text` reason instead of decoding raw image bytes into a mojibake `PasteboardText`.

Regression tests in `test/cli/clipboard_reader_test.dart`:
- `the Linux text backends pin the text content type` — asserts xclip gets `-t text/plain;charset=utf-8` and wl-paste gets `--type text/plain;charset=utf-8`
- `an image-only Linux clipboard is not dumped into the composer` — both pinned backends failing yields the named unavailable, never text
","path":"outputs/review_replies/thread_3.md"}

# gh-1575 rework — all 7 review threads addressed, CI root cause fixed

## Issues/Notes

- 🚨 **BLOCKING (CI + thread 1)** — `fa_tui.dart` was 2807 lines > the 2800 loc gate (single root cause of both failed CI checks). **Fixed**: `FaTuiCallbacks` (~114 lines) moved verbatim into a new part file `lib/src/cli/fa_tui_callbacks.dart` (`part of 'fa_tui.dart'` — same precedent as `fa_tui_paste.dart`; no public API moves). `fa_tui.dart` is now **2694 lines**; `crap4dart.yaml` `max_lines` untouched ("only down").
- ⚠️ **IMPORTANT (thread 2)** — Windows text read was OEM-encoded, not UTF-8, and kept embedded `\r\n`. **Fixed**: `Get-Clipboard` now runs with `[Console]::OutputEncoding=[System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8` pinned on the same command line, and every embedded `\r\n` is normalized to `\n` after the single trailing-newline strip.
- ⚠️ **IMPORTANT (thread 3)** — Linux text backends were not type-pinned, so `wl-paste --no-newline` could dump raw image bytes as "text" for an image-only clipboard. **Fixed**: `xclip … -t text/plain;charset=utf-8 -o` and `wl-paste --type text/plain;charset=utf-8 --no-newline`; an image-only clipboard now fails both backends and keeps the named unavailable reason.
- 💡 **SUGGESTION (thread 4)** — library doc overclaimed `FA_FAKE_PASTEBOARD` "short-circuits everything". **Fixed**: the header now states it short-circuits the IMAGE read only and the TEXT read has no fake seam (script it via the injected `ProcessRunner`).
- 💡 **SUGGESTION (thread 5)** — `dart format` dirt in `test/cli/clipboard_reader_test.dart`. **Fixed**: re-formatted with SDK stable 3.13.5 (the SDK CI pins); pre-existing dirt in `clipboard_reader.dart` / `fa_tui_stub.dart` / `fa_tui_paste_flow_test.dart` deliberately left untouched, per the review note.
- Threads 6 (top-level "Automated Code Review — REQUEST_CHANGES" summary) and 7 (`dmtools:review-verdict` machine record) carry no `threadId`/`rootCommentId` in `pr_discussions_raw.json`; thread 7 is explicitly marked "do not edit or reply", and thread 6 is the top-level review whose items (1–4) are all fixed and itemized above — this comment is the top-level reply.
- Also concluded the prepared merge of `origin/main` (gh-1511) into the branch — it was staged conflict-free; verified no markers (`git diff --check` clean) and committed it before rework.
- Local SDK is 3.13.5 — identical to CI's pin; `dart analyze` is clean on every changed file (the only workspace errors are pre-existing `office_addin` sibling-package resolution noise, untouched by this PR and not a CI leg).

## Approach

- TDD, per finding: wrote the failing regression tests first (3 new tests failed exactly on the reviewed gaps: missing UTF-8 pin, surviving embedded `\r\n`, missing type pins), then made the minimal library change to turn them green, then re-ran the full suite.
- The loc-gate fix is a pure mechanical move (no code edits inside the moved block) verified by `wc -l`, `dart analyze` and the full suite; part-file registration added to `fa_tui.dart`'s `part` list.
- No behavior outside the reviewed findings was touched: bracketed-paste routing, gesture pairing (#1067) and silent-failure semantics are unchanged; the text fallback still rides Ctrl+V only.
- CHANGELOG's Unreleased gh-1575 entry extended with the review-pass clauses.

## Files Modified

- `lib/src/cli/fa_tui_callbacks.dart` — **new** part file: `FaTuiCallbacks` moved verbatim from `fa_tui.dart` (loc-gate fix).
- `lib/src/cli/fa_tui.dart` — `FaTuiCallbacks` block removed, `part 'fa_tui_callbacks.dart';` added (2807 → 2694 lines).
- `lib/src/cli/clipboard_reader.dart` — UTF-8 pin + embedded `\r\n`→`\n` normalization in `_readWindowsText`; type pins in `_readLinuxText`; library doc corrected.
- `test/cli/clipboard_reader_test.dart` — 4 new regression tests (UTF-8 pin, CRLF normalization, type pins, image-only-not-text) + format pass.
- `CHANGELOG.md` — review-pass clauses appended to the Unreleased gh-1575 entry.
- `outputs/review_replies.json` + `outputs/review_replies/thread_{1..5}.md` — one reply per open inline thread.

## Test Coverage

- New RED→GREEN regression tests (all now passing):
  - `the Windows text command pins UTF-8 on the console encoding`
  - `the Windows text path normalizes embedded CRLF to LF`
  - `the Linux text backends pin the text content type`
  - `an image-only Linux clipboard is not dumped into the composer`
- Targeted: `dart test test/cli/clipboard_reader_test.dart test/cli/fa_tui_paste_flow_test.dart` → **40 passed** (incl. the pre-existing TIFF/sips/fall-through and Ctrl+V flow tests — no regressions).
- Full suite: `dart test` — see the run log for the final count (10.5k+ tests); `wc -l lib/src/cli/fa_tui.dart` → 2694 re-proves the loc gate.

# Issue #1234: the ≤2800-line file guard MOVED into crap4dart's loc
      # gate (crap4dart.yaml, wc -l parity verified by the maintainer
      # recipe in the issue) — enforced whole-tree by the
      # `crap4dart check --baseline` Quality-gates step below. The shell
      # find-exec guard (gh-1232 AC2) is gone: one enforcement point, no
      # drifted exclusions.

      # Issue #1100: the fa-web-spa.zip packaging guard (base-tag patch +
      # absolute-/app/ grep) must stay functional on every PR — a release
      # run is the wrong place to first discover a broken guard. Fixture
      # self-test: positive path + all red exits, pure bash, no web build.
      - name: Web SPA packaging guard self-test (#1100)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          d=$(mktemp -d)
          trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
          mkdir -p "$d/build"
          printf '<html><head>\n<base href="/app/">\n</head></html>\n' > "$d/build/index.html"
          for f in flutter_service_worker.js flutter_bootstrap.js; do echo "// $f" > "$d/build/$f"; done
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/out.zip" > /dev/null
          unzip -p "$d/out.zip" index.html | grep -F '<base href="./">'
          # AC4 pin: packaging never mutates its input — the Pages deploy's
          # build dir must stay byte-identical.
          grep -F '<base href="/app/">' "$d/build/index.html"
          # Red exit 1: an absolute /app/ sneaking into a touchpoint.
          echo '{"x":"/app/y"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed a build containing /app/ (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 2: no base tag to patch.
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"

      # Issue #1100: the fa-web-spa.zip packaging guard (base-tag patch +
      # absolute-/app/ grep) must stay functional on every PR — a release
      # run is the wrong place to first discover a broken guard. Fixture
      # self-test: positive path + all red exits, pure bash, no web build.
      - name: Web SPA packaging guard self-test (#1100)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          d=$(mktemp -d)
          trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
          mkdir -p "$d/build"
          printf '<html><head>\n<base href="/app/">\n</head></html>\n' > "$d/build/index.html"
          for f in flutter_service_worker.js flutter_bootstrap.js; do echo "// $f" > "$d/build/$f"; done
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/out.zip" > /dev/null
          unzip -p "$d/out.zip" index.html | grep -F '<base href="./">'
          # AC4 pin: packaging never mutates its input — the Pages deploy's
          # build dir must stay byte-identical.
          grep -F '<base href="/app/">' "$d/build/index.html"
          # Red exit 1: an absolute /app/ sneaking into a touchpoint.
          echo '{"x":"/app/y"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed a build containing /app/ (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 2: no base tag to patch.
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"

      - name: Web SPA packaging guard self-test (#1100)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          d=$(mktemp -d)
          trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
          mkdir -p "$d/build"
          printf '<html><head>\n<base href="/app/">\n</head></html>\n' > "$d/build/index.html"

await runner('powershell', [

]) {

{"content":"# gh-1575 rework — all 7 review threads addressed, CI root cause fixed

## Issues/Notes

- 🚨 **BLOCKING (CI + thread 1)** — `fa_tui.dart` was 2807 lines > the 2800 loc gate (single root cause of both failed CI checks). **Fixed**: `FaTuiCallbacks` (~114 lines) moved verbatim into a new part file `lib/src/cli/fa_tui_callbacks.dart` (`part of 'fa_tui.dart'` — same precedent as `fa_tui_paste.dart`; no public API moves). `fa_tui.dart` is now **2694 lines**; `crap4dart.yaml` `max_lines` untouched ("only down").
- ⚠️ **IMPORTANT (thread 2)** — Windows text read was OEM-encoded, not UTF-8, and kept embedded `\r\n`. **Fixed**: `Get-Clipboard` now runs with `[Console]::OutputEncoding=[System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8` pinned on the same command line, and every embedded `\r\n` is normalized to `\n` after the single trailing-newline strip.
- ⚠️ **IMPORTANT (thread 3)** — Linux text backends were not type-pinned, so `wl-paste --no-newline` could dump raw image bytes as "text" for an image-only clipboard. **Fixed**: `xclip … -t text/plain;charset=utf-8 -o` and `wl-paste --type text/plain;charset=utf-8 --no-newline`; an image-only clipboard now fails both backends and keeps the named unavailable reason.
- 💡 **SUGGESTION (thread 4)** — library doc overclaimed `FA_FAKE_PASTEBOARD` "short-circuits everything". **Fixed**: the header now states it short-circuits the IMAGE read only and the TEXT read has no fake seam (script it via the injected `ProcessRunner`).
- 💡 **SUGGESTION (thread 5)** — `dart format` dirt in `test/cli/clipboard_reader_test.dart`. **Fixed**: re-formatted with SDK stable 3.13.5 (the SDK CI pins); pre-existing dirt in `clipboard_reader.dart` / `fa_tui_stub.dart` / `fa_tui_paste_flow_test.dart` deliberately left untouched, per the review note.
- Threads 6 (top-level "Automated Code Review — REQUEST_CHANGES" summary) and 7 (`dmtools:review-verdict` machine record) carry no `threadId`/`rootCommentId` in `pr_discussions_raw.json`; thread 7 is explicitly marked "do not edit or reply", and thread 6 is the top-level review whose items (1–4) are all fixed and itemized above — this comment is the top-level reply.
- Also concluded the prepared merge of `origin/main` (gh-1511) into the branch — it was staged conflict-free; verified no markers (`git diff --check` clean) and committed it before rework.
- Local SDK is 3.13.5 — identical to CI's pin; `dart analyze` is clean on every changed file (the only workspace errors are pre-existing `office_addin` sibling-package resolution noise, untouched by this PR and not a CI leg).

## Approach

- TDD, per finding: wrote the failing regression tests first (3 new tests failed exactly on the reviewed gaps: missing UTF-8 pin, surviving embedded `\r\n`, missing type pins), then made the minimal library change to turn them green, then re-ran the full suite.
- The loc-gate fix is a pure mechanical move (no code edits inside the moved block) verified by `wc -l`, `dart analyze` and the full suite; part-file registration added to `fa_tui.dart`'s `part` list.
- No behavior outside the reviewed findings was touched: bracketed-paste routing, gesture pairing (#1067) and silent-failure semantics are unchanged; the text fallback still rides Ctrl+V only.
- CHANGELOG's Unreleased gh-1575 entry extended with the review-pass clauses.

## Files Modified

- `lib/src/cli/fa_tui_callbacks.dart` — **new** part file: `FaTuiCallbacks` moved verbatim from `fa_tui.dart` (loc-gate fix).
- `lib/src/cli/fa_tui.dart` — `FaTuiCallbacks` block removed, `part 'fa_tui_callbacks.dart';` added (2807 → 2694 lines).
- `lib/src/cli/clipboard_reader.dart` — UTF-8 pin + embedded `\r\n`→`\n` normalization in `_readWindowsText`; type pins in `_readLinuxText`; library doc corrected.
- `test/cli/clipboard_reader_test.dart` — 4 new regression tests (UTF-8 pin, CRLF normalization, type pins, image-only-not-text) + format pass.
- `CHANGELOG.md` — review-pass clauses appended to the Unreleased gh-1575 entry.
- `outputs/review_replies.json` + `outputs/review_replies/thread_{1..5}.md` — one reply per open inline thread.

## Test Coverage

- New RED→GREEN regression tests (all now passing):
  - `the Windows text command pins UTF-8 on the console encoding`
  - `the Windows text path normalizes embedded CRLF to LF`
  - `the Linux text backends pin the text content type`
  - `an image-only Linux clipboard is not dumped into the composer`

# Issue #1234: the ≤2800-line file guard MOVED into crap4dart's loc
      # gate (crap4dart.yaml, wc -l parity verified by the maintainer
      # recipe in the issue) — enforced whole-tree by the
      # `crap4dart check --baseline` Quality-gates step below. The shell
      # find-exec guard (gh-1232 AC2) is gone: one enforcement point, no
      # drifted exclusions.

      # Issue #1100: the fa-web-spa.zip packaging guard (base-tag patch +
      # absolute-/app/ grep) must stay functional on every PR — a release
      # run is the wrong place to first discover a broken guard. Fixture
      # self-test: positive path + all red exits, pure bash, no web build.
      - name: Web SPA packaging guard self-test (#1100)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          d=$(mktemp -d)
          trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
          mkdir -p "$d/build"
          printf '<html><head>\n<base href="/app/">\n</head></html>\n' > "$d/build/index.html"
          for f in flutter_service_worker.js flutter_bootstrap.js; do echo "// $f" > "$d/build/$f"; done
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/out.zip" > /dev/null
          unzip -p "$d/out.zip" index.html | grep -F '<base href="./">'
          # AC4 pin: packaging never mutates its input — the Pages deploy's
          # build dir must stay byte-identical.
          grep -F '<base href="/app/">' "$d/build/index.html"
          # Red exit 1: an absolute /app/ sneaking into a touchpoint.
          echo '{"x":"/app/y"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed a build containing /app/ (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 2: no base tag to patch.
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"

## Unreleased

- gh-1575: macOS clipboard paste fixed for TIFF-only pasteboards + the
  Ctrl+V text fallback. `_readMacos` probes `«class TIFF»` after PNGf/JPEG
  miss and converts via `sips -s format png` (a Preview/browser copy used
  to dead-end on `clipboard holds no image`; a failed conversion keeps the
  unavailable fall-through and every scratch file is cleaned up); new
  `readPasteboardText` (`pbpaste` / xclip+wl-paste / PowerShell
  Get-Clipboard) behind the same injectable `ProcessRunner`/`platform:`
  seam, and Ctrl+V with a TEXT clipboard now inserts the clipboard text
  into the composer instead of printing the image probe's dead-end reason
  — bracketed-paste routing, gesture pairing and silent-failure semantics
  unchanged.

- gh-1556: bench pipeline stops bleeding score + fa deadline awareness.

{"content":"## Fixed — Windows text read is now UTF-8-pinned and CRLF-normalized

`_readWindowsText` (`lib/src/cli/clipboard_reader.dart`) mirrors the suggested fix:

```dart
await runner('powershell', [
  '-NoProfile',
  '-Command',
  '[Console]::OutputEncoding=[System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8; Get-Clipboard',
])
```

- UTF-8 console output encoding pinned on the same command line, so the stream the reader decodes is UTF-8 — non-ASCII clipboard text ("café", "Привет", CJK) no longer degrades to U+FFFD.
- Embedded line breaks normalized: after the single PowerShell trailing-newline strip, every remaining `\r\n` becomes `\n` (`replaceAll`), so multi-line clipboard text reaches the composer verbatim as the clipboard held it.

","path":"outputs/review_replies/thread_2.md"}

{"content":"## Fixed — Linux text backends are type-pinned exactly as suggested

`_readLinuxText` (`lib/src/cli/clipboard_reader.dart`) now pins the text types the same way the image path pins `image/png`:

```dart
for (final (executable, args) in [
  ('xclip', ['-selection', 'clipboard', '-t', 'text/plain;charset=utf-8', '-o']),
  ('wl-paste', ['--type', 'text/plain;charset=utf-8', '--no-newline']),
]) {
```

      - name: Web SPA packaging guard self-test (#1100)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          d=$(mktemp -d)
          trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
          mkdir -p "$d/build"
          printf '<html><head>\n<base href="/app/">\n</head></html>\n' > "$d/build/index.html"

## Unreleased

- gh-1575: macOS clipboard paste fixed for TIFF-only pasteboards + the
  Ctrl+V text fallback. `_readMacos` probes `«class TIFF»` after PNGf/JPEG
  miss and converts via `sips -s format png` (a Preview/browser copy used
  to dead-end on `clipboard holds no image`; a failed conversion keeps the
  unavailable fall-through and every scratch file is cleaned up); new
  `readPasteboardText` (`pbpaste` / xclip+wl-paste / PowerShell
  Get-Clipboard) behind the same injectable `ProcessRunner`/`platform:`
  seam, and Ctrl+V with a TEXT clipboard now inserts the clipboard text
  into the composer instead of printing the image probe's dead-end reason
  — bracketed-paste routing, gesture pairing and silent-failure semantics
  unchanged.

- gh-1556: bench pipeline stops bleeding score + fa deadline awareness.
  Bench: the harbor ladder kill uses the `[f]a` bracket trick and is

{"content":"## Fixed — Windows text read is now UTF-8-pinned and CRLF-normalized

`_readWindowsText` (`lib/src/cli/clipboard_reader.dart`) mirrors the suggested fix:

```dart
await runner('powershell', [
  '-NoProfile',
  '-Command',
  '[Console]::OutputEncoding=[System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8; Get-Clipboard',
])
```

- UTF-8 console output encoding pinned on the same command line, so the stream the reader decodes is UTF-8 — non-ASCII clipboard text ("café", "Привет", CJK) no longer degrades to U+FFFD.
- Embedded line breaks normalized: after the single PowerShell trailing-newline strip, every remaining `\r\n` becomes `\n` (`replaceAll`), so multi-line clipboard text reaches the composer verbatim as the clipboard held it.

Regression tests in `test/cli/clipboard_reader_test.dart`:
- `the Windows text command pins UTF-8 on the console encoding` — asserts the emitted command carries the `[Console]::OutputEncoding=...::UTF8` pin and `Get-Clipboard`
- `the Windows text path normalizes embedded CRLF to LF` — `line one\r\nline two\r\n` → `line one\nline two`

(Host-side OEM-encoding behavior itself stays untestable on the Linux CI runner, as noted — the command contract and the normalization are pinned by tests.)
","path":"outputs/review_replies/thread_2.md"}

{"content":"## Fixed — Linux text backends are type-pinned exactly as suggested

`_readLinuxText` (`lib/src/cli/clipboard_reader.dart`) now pins the text types the same way the image path pins `image/png`:

```dart
for (final (executable, args) in [
  ('xclip', ['-selection', 'clipboard', '-t', 'text/plain;charset=utf-8', '-o']),
  ('wl-paste', ['--type', 'text/plain;charset=utf-8', '--no-newline']),
]) {
```

- With explicit types, an image-only clipboard (e.g. JPEG-only — the image reader only probes `image/png`) fails both backends and the Ctrl+V fallback keeps the correct named `xclip/wl-paste unavailable or clipboard holds no text` reason instead of decoding raw image bytes into a mojibake `PasteboardText`.

- `an image-only Linux clipboard is not dumped into the composer` — both pinned backends failing yields the named unavailable, never text
","path":"outputs/review_replies/thread_3.md"}

- ⚠️ **IMPORTANT (thread 2)** — Windows text read was OEM-encoded, not UTF-8, and kept embedded `\r\n`. **Fixed**: `Get-Clipboard` now runs with `[Console]::OutputEncoding=[System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8` pinned on the same command line, and every embedded `\r\n` is normalized to `\n` after the single trailing-newline strip.

{"content":"## Fixed — Windows text read is now UTF-8-pinned and CRLF-normalized

`_readWindowsText` (`lib/src/cli/clipboard_reader.dart`) mirrors the suggested fix:

```dart
await runner('powershell', [
  '-NoProfile',
  '-Command',
  '[Console]::OutputEncoding=[System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8; Get-Clipboard',
])
```

- UTF-8 console output encoding pinned on the same command line, so the stream the reader decodes is UTF-8 — non-ASCII clipboard text ("café", "Привет", CJK) no longer degrades to U+FFFD.
- Embedded line breaks normalized: after the single PowerShell trailing-newline strip, every remaining `\r\n` becomes `\n` (`replaceAll`), so multi-line clipboard text reaches the composer verbatim as the clipboard held it.

","path":"outputs/review_replies/thread_2.md"}

{"content":"## Fixed — Linux text backends are type-pinned exactly as suggested

for (final (executable, args) in [
  ('xclip', ['-selection', 'clipboard', '-t', 'text/plain;charset=utf-8', '-o']),
  ('wl-paste', ['--type', 'text/plain;charset=utf-8', '--no-newline']),
]) {

      # recipe in the issue) — enforced whole-tree by the

      # Issue #1100: the fa-web-spa.zip packaging guard (base-tag patch +
      # absolute-/app/ grep) must stay functional on every PR — a release
      # run is the wrong place to first discover a broken guard. Fixture
      # self-test: positive path + all red exits, pure bash, no web build.
      - name: Web SPA packaging guard self-test (#1100)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          d=$(mktemp -d)
          trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
          mkdir -p "$d/build"
          printf '<html><head>\n<base href="/app/">\n</head></html>\n' > "$d/build/index.html"
          for f in flutter_service_worker.js flutter_bootstrap.js; do echo "// $f" > "$d/build/$f"; done
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/out.zip" > /dev/null
          unzip -p "$d/out.zip" index.html | grep -F '<base href="./">'
          # AC4 pin: packaging never mutates its input — the Pages deploy's
          # build dir must stay byte-identical.
          grep -F '<base href="/app/">' "$d/build/index.html"
          # Red exit 1: an absolute /app/ sneaking into a touchpoint.
          echo '{"x":"/app/y"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          if bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/bad.zip" 2>/dev/null; then
            echo "::error::package_web_spa guard passed a build containing /app/ (AC3 #1100)"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Red exit 2: no base tag to patch.
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"

```dart
await runner('powershell', [
  '-NoProfile',

","path":"outputs/review_replies/thread_2.md"}

for (final (executable, args) in [

  ('wl-paste', ['--type', 'text/plain;charset=utf-8', '--no-newline']),
]) {
```

      - name: Web SPA packaging guard self-test (#1100)
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          d=$(mktemp -d)
          trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
          mkdir -p "$d/build"
          printf '<html><head>\n<base href="/app/">\n</head></html>\n' > "$d/build/index.html"
          for f in flutter_service_worker.js flutter_bootstrap.js; do echo "// $f" > "$d/build/$f"; done
          echo '{"name":"fa"}' > "$d/build/manifest.json"
          bash scripts/package_web_spa.sh "$d/build" "$d/out.zip" > /dev/null
